sloka: सङ्गृह्य तं तु दौहित्रं प्रविष्टः सागरं तदा ।आर्यकः स हि तस्यासीत्पुलोमा येन सा शची ।। ७.२८.२० ॥
transliteration: saṅgṛhya taṁ tu dauhitraṁ praviṣṭaḥ sāgaraṁ tadā ।āryakaḥ sa hi tasyāsītpulomā yena sā śacī ।। 7.28.20 ॥

translations.english: Having seized his grandson, Puloma then entered the ocean, for he was indeed the maternal grandfather of Jayanta, as Shachi was his daughter.
